purpose: Cross-validate horizontal accelerometer-bias observability without reusing the legacy multisine bias-convergence trajectory.

coordinate_contract.truth_kinematics_time_semantics: row_i acceleration is held on (t[i-1], t[i]] and endpoint velocity/position truth is integrated with the same held value

trajectories.description: Axis-separated and diagonal minimum-jerk hover position corrections with fixed yaw.
Minimum-jerk takeoff, N/E/S/W hover box, descent, touchdown, and final static dwell.
The same NED hover correction repeated at yaw 0, 90, 180, and 270 degrees.
VTOL takeoff, acceleration to forward flight, shallow S-turn, braking, hover, and landing.
Hover followed by deterministic crosswind-like lateral displacement, descent, flare, and touchdown dwell.

anti_overfit_rules: The protocol file and semantic SHA-256 are recorded before estimator tuning.
Train, tune, and holdout seed ranges must be pairwise disjoint.
Truth attitude, position, velocity, and bias are analyzer-only and must not initialize the filter.
A candidate source SHA is selected before release holdout execution.
Holdout failures cannot be tuned against; further tuning requires a new protocol version while retaining v1 results.
Gates apply per trajectory and exact bias vector; aggregate averages cannot hide a failing direction.
Right-censored non-settling trials remain failures and cannot be removed from percentile reports.
